name: Definite
tagline: AI-native data platform: warehouse, ETL, BI, and agents in one.
description: Definite is a data-platform-as-a-service that bundles a managed warehouse, ETL pipelines, modeling, and BI into one AI-native product. Its assistant, Fi, turns natural-language questions into SQL and builds full data apps — filters, KPIs, and tables — not just charts. It ships 500+ connectors and exposes data to external agents like Claude and Cursor over MCP.
insight: Raised a $10M seed led by Costanoa Ventures in 2025; built on open-source DuckDB and Apache Iceberg to avoid lock-in.

modelSupport.notes: Fi natural-language-to-SQL assistant; also connects external agents (Claude, Cursor) via MCP.

edge: Collapses warehouse, ETL, and BI into one platform that spins up in minutes, instead of stitching separate tools together over months.
